    Real Mallorca defeated Real Madrid 2-1 on April 4, 2026, in La Liga, with Carlo Ancelotti's rotated side struggling ahead of the Champions League. Key starters
    Kylian Mbappé and Antonio Rüdiger played, while Jude Bellingham and Vinícius Júnior came off the bench. Mallorca was led by Vedat Muriqi and keeper Leo Román. 
    Real Madrid Starting XI (vs. Mallorca - 04/04/2026): 
    • Goalkeeper: Andriy Lunin
    • Defenders: Trent Alexander-Arnold, Antonio Rüdiger, Dean Huijsen, Álvaro Carreras
    • Midfielders: Aurélien Tchouaméni, Eduardo Camavinga, Arda Güler, Manuel Ángel
    • Forwards: Brahim Díaz, Kylian Mbappé
    • Subs Used: Jude Bellingham, Éder Militão, Vinícius Júnior 
    RCD Mallorca Predicted Starting XI: 
    • Goalkeeper: Leo Román
    • Defenders: Pablo Maffeo, Martin Valjent, David López, Johan Mojica (or Toni Lato)
    • Midfielders: Omar Mascarell, Samu Costa, Zito Luvumbo, Pablo Torre, Mateo Joseph
    • Forward: Vedat Muriqi 
    Note: Real Madrid rotated heavily for this match, with Álvaro Arbeloa overseeing the side in this specific 2026 fixture.
